articles.title: PM asks justice secretary to find way to keep PC Harper's killers in jail
articles.description: Andy Burnham is confident a solution can be found to exclude two of PC Harper's killers from an early release scheme, the BBC understands.

articles.title: Amber heat health alerts for almost all of England as next heatwave begins
articles.description: The amber alerts will be in place until Friday evening to cover high and even extreme temperatures expected through this week.

articles.title: Councils to get more powers to stop vape and betting shops, PM announces
articles.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said town centres had been "hollowed out" by decades of decline.

articles.title: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest  earthquake in years
articles.description: More than 480 people were injured in the quakes, with more feared trapped under collapsed buildings.
